title: Week of Aug 17–23
subtitle: Block 3, Big-4 retest — Week 1 (calibration). Lifts slid one more day: Wed lower · Thu quality run · Fri upper · Sat full body · Sun recovery. Ramp to top sets at ~2 RIR and log the baselines.
goals: First: congratulations. Engaged, Red Sox with your brother, a couple days of walking around town — the block just slides, nothing is lost. Tuesday's 4-miler happened, the lift didn't, so the three lifting days now run Wed / Fri / Sat. Saturday calisthenics sits out this week and its one anchor (the max pull-up benchmark) lives inside Saturday's full-body day.

This is the calibration week for the Big-4 retest. Every main lift ramps to ONE top set at ~2 RIR — you log what the bar gives you, and weeks 2–3 build from those numbers toward the Block-1 bests (Squat 200×5, Bench 190, DL 275, OHP ~115 strict). Nothing is a test this week. The listed targets are placeholders from Block 1; if 2 RIR says less, log less without a second thought.

The rebuilt frame protects what matters most: squats today on fresh legs, and Saturday's deadlift calibration with two easy days for the legs in between (Friday is upper only). The cost is Thursday's quality run landing the day after squats — it's threshold, not a race, and there's built-in permission to trim it.

Mileage: Tue 4 (done), Thu 5.5 with the quality work, Fri 1.5 post-lift, Sat 2 post-lift, Sun 2.5 easy — ~17.5 for the week. A touch under the block's ~20 because Monday and Tuesday both went to celebrating; that's the right trade and week 2 sits back at 20.

Strict OHP retests this block (form broke down at 125 back in June — that's why Block 2 ran push press). Friday is strict only: no leg drive, no layback. And the back-care protocol stays on every hinge: extra warm-up, controlled eccentrics, zero grind.

Food: maintenance, full stop. Band is 189–191 and the waist is the arbiter. You're fueling PR attempts for the next three weeks — eat to the SMART goal at deficit 0 and don't react to day-to-day scale noise after a restaurant-heavy celebration stretch.

Saturday update (8/22): a 4th movement (lateral raise + face pull superset) and a 6-set core circuit (hanging leg raise, ab wheel, side plank). That is the new floor for every lift day from here: at least 6 core sets across 2–3 movements, one superset of 2–3 exercises, and core movements rotating through the block's pool instead of repeating.
review: The bridge week did its job: ~13 easy miles, two moderate re-entry lifts, short cabin weekend, sleep re-regulated. Block 2 stays banked — Front Squat 145, Incline 155, Push Press 145, Paused DL 225, pull-up benchmark 18, first 20+ mile week of the rebuild. Then the best possible reason to slide the start: an engagement. Monday and Tuesday went to celebrating (plus a 4-miler), and the barbell work starts today. Three lifting days in the next four set the baselines the whole block progresses from — ramp honestly to 2 RIR, log it, and let weeks 2–3 do the chasing.

days.name: Quality Run — Threshold Intervals
warmup: 2×20s relaxed strides before the first interval

run.title: Threshold Intervals — 5.5 mi total
run.detail: First quality run since July, on real road. 1.5 mi easy warm-up → 3 × 5 min at threshold effort (comfortably hard — short sentences, not paragraphs) with 2–3 min easy jog between → easy cool-down to round out 5.5. The legs will carry Wednesday's squats — that's expected. If rep 1 feels like more than 'comfortably hard', trim the reps to 4 min and call it a full success. Controlled is the whole assignment. Log your entered miles, not the watch.

days.name: Full Body — Deadlift Calibration + Pull-up Benchmark
warmup: 3 min on rower, stairmaster, or erg — easy pace
Cat-cow + slow bodyweight good mornings — 10 reps (back care)
2 easy hangs from the bar — 20s each, open the lats

items.note: Ramp 135/185/225/250 — conventional returns after a block of paused work, with two easy leg days behind you by design. Top set at ~2 RIR; 250×4 is the placeholder off your 275. Full back protocol: perfect setup every rep, controlled down, ZERO grind. Back talks → cap at 225 and move on.
items.focus: Bar over midfoot, brace hard, push the floor away.

items.note: 55s–60s — smooth tens after Friday's barbell work.
items.focus: Control the descent, press up and slightly together.

items.note: THE benchmark returns — one all-out set, fresh, strict. Block 2 exit was 18. This is the week's one to-failure set; everything else stays submax. (Friday's pulling was rows and pulldowns, so the lats come in ready.)
items.focus: Full hang to chin clearly over, no kipping, fight for the last clean rep.

items.note: 2×6 easy back-off sets, 3+ in reserve — volume, not testing.
items.focus: Same strict standard, smooth tempo.

items.note: The 4th move, and the one gap in this week: no side or rear delt work anywhere yet. 12 lateral raises (15s, strict, no swing) straight into 15 face pulls (rope at face height, pull to the ears, pause), then 60s rest. 3 rounds, 2–3 in reserve. Nothing here loads the low back.
items.focus: Lead with the elbows on the raise; elbows high and pull the rope apart on the face pull.

items.note: Core finisher is a 3-move circuit, 6 sets total: leg raise → ab wheel → side plank, twice through, ~20s between moves.
items.focus: Control the lower, no swinging.

items.note: Rotated in from the block's core pool. Brace like the top of a deadlift and roll out only as far as the hips stay tucked. If the low back is talking after the deadlifts, use the substitute button: Hollow Body Hold, 2×30s.
items.focus: Ribs down, hips tucked, no sag in the back.
Stack the hips, straight line head to feet, push the floor away.
